upstream.name: quaestio
upstream.verification: On 2026-09-14 `shasum -a 256 -c SKILL_MANIFEST.sha256` reported OK for all 10 manifest entries at this revision. The checkout also had an uncommitted README.md change; README.md was not used as a source.

sources_not_used.reason: Candidate question development is P6 scope.
Synthesis and assumption analysis are P6 scope.
Domain-specific model audit; not part of the first slice.
Source register for methodology audits; not loaded at runtime.

adaptations.change: Kept calibration rules (reading depth, absent evidence is not originality, no manufactured positive result, versions not independent). Replaced repository/host-register assumptions with application StepInput records. Added data-versus-instruction boundary, allowlisted identifiers, no-tool statement, explicit unsupported modes and schema echo rules.

Search plan keeps vocabulary families, essential-versus-desired conditions, no AND-everything queries, question-driven date limits and no exhaustiveness claim. Screening adds include/exclude/uncertain proposals with keyword false-positive guard. Grounded answer keeps original-passage checking, access limits and contradiction handling, expressed as claim-to-passage links. Search logging, citation chasing, sentinel sets and bibliometric maps are application or later-stage responsibilities and were not copied. 2026-09-16 (D44): the search plan names concepts (exactly one core) and providers; query writing, per-provider syntax and date limits were removed because the application compiles the queries.

Written for DEIXIS on 2026-09-14 (D14), not adapted from upstream text. Applies the SKILL.md evidence rules (reading depth, source_stated versus analyst_inference) to a per-claim verdict on the passages each claim cites. Loaded into answer_review steps only.

Written for DEIXIS on 2026-09-16 (D37, D38), not adapted from upstream text. Applies the SKILL.md evidence rules to evidence table cells: column instructions followed as by a human annotator, the four model cell states, no unit conversion, exact quotes per cited passage, no locators in notes; and to column suggestions. 2026-09-16 (D43): one evidence item per quoted span, several spans of one passage allowed, the cited passage must be the one containing the quote. Loaded into cell_extraction and table_columns steps only.

Written for DEIXIS on 2026-09-17 (P6 slice 1), not adapted from upstream text. Applies SKILL.md's evidence rules to the fixed report skeleton: report_plan, per-section instructions for III-IX/abstract/index_terms, VI/VII's narrowed gap/future-direction exception to the candidate-development ban, phrase repair, and report review. Loaded into report_plan, report_section, report_phrase_repair and report_review steps only. 2026-09-18: made the supplied per-section frames mandatory for every claims[].text and insufficient_evidence[].reason sentence because the first real-model report run produced sentences that followed no frame; evidence support explicitly outranks frame fit.

phrasebank.source: Academic Phrasebank, 2015 enhanced edition (John Morley, The University of Manchester), phrase sections of printed pages 7-91. Copyright remains with The University of Manchester.
phrasebank.form: converted once on 2026-09-14: one frame per list item under # section and ## subsection headings, table rows written with {a | b} alternatives; nine frames split or joined by the conversion were repaired by hand
phrasebank.turkish: each frame is followed by a `tr:` line, a literal Turkish rendering written on 2026-09-14 by Claude Sonnet subagents; checked by script for equal alternative groups and slots, spot-read by the implementing agent, not reviewed by a human translator
phrasebank.use: versioned at the user's decision (2026-09-14); loaded into grounded_answer and report_section steps, English frames or their Turkish renderings by question language; grounded-answer sentences and report-section prose sentences are checked against the frames of the answer language; its hash is part of skill_package_hash

upstream_update_policy: Quaestio changes are not imported automatically. A change is compared by diff, recorded here with the new revision and hashes, and re-tested with the behavior cases before the package version changes.
distribution_review: not_done; required before public distribution of adapted text
behavioral_validation: development cases run on 2026-09-14 with Codex gpt-5.6-luna and rerun on 2026-09-15 after the phrasebank rules (D15), every automatic check passing on the single attempt; the unsupported-mode rule was tightened after MB06 failed. The search-plan wording was subsequently revised for the in-sample packet-size P4 measurement; earlier behavior cases are no longer executions of the current instruction hash. One baseline and one revised packet-size run are recorded locally, but no held-out evaluation or human claim review has been completed; see tests/model_behavior/cases.json and .local/p4-eval-2026-09-15-packet/analysis.md. On 2026-09-16 (D44) the search-plan section was rewritten for SearchPlan v2: the model gives concepts with exactly one core concept and the providers, and the application compiles the queries; no behavior case has been run on this wording. On 2026-09-17 (D57) the core-concept rule gained a domain-versus-method-field sentence with a power-grid example; the stored search_plan StepInput of one live research was re-run three times with gpt-5.6-luna before and after the change (in-sample for that one question; results in .local/search-plan-core-2026-09-17).
